Rule: Students are generally shielded from the greater ongoing dynastic and political schemes of adult society.
What Characters Believe: Dragging students into adult house warfare is widely frowned upon.
Practical Consequence: Families and institutions normally wait until graduation/adult standing before openly tasking heirs as political operatives.
Exceptions / Unknowns: Covert grooming or indirect pressure may exist, but overt adult political use of students is taboo.
Notes: Makes Silver Night a social transgression as well as a massacre.

Rule: Graduation certifies entry into the adult political world.
What Characters Believe: After graduation the Seven are legitimate adult actors whom houses may court, task, recruit, marry, pressure, and deploy.
Practical Consequence: The early series should move from eager student naivety into abrupt exposure to real political machinery.
Exceptions / Unknowns: Exact legal wording and age mechanics remain open.

Rule: Most of the Last Seven begin eager, comparatively naive, and undereducated in the brutal practical ways of adult politics.
What Characters Believe: Academy excellence does not equal worldly experience.
Practical Consequence: Growth should include learning to lie, negotiate, recognize coercion, survive betrayal, use leverage, and decide what they refuse to become.
Exceptions / Unknowns: Individual exceptions may be more worldly due to family, tutors, travel, trauma, or prior duties.

Rule: Silver Night violated the norm against using students as pieces in adult dynastic warfare.
What Characters Believe: Killing students for future political advantage is especially dangerous.
Practical Consequence: Discovery risks backlash from Academy, families of the dead, sacred orders, and otherwise neutral actors.
Notes: Casualty count remains 36 students and 6 servants.

Rule: Part of the emerging motive behind the student killings is demographic succession pressure: one noble family had become unusually successful at producing heirs, alarming a rival.
What Characters Believe: A large future cohort can shift chairs, licenses, tribunals, marriages, and coalition arithmetic before taking office.
Practical Consequence: The killings pre-empted a future generation's political weight as well as current students.
Exceptions / Unknowns: Which expanding family, which rival, and exact numbers remain unresolved.
Notes: Must reconcile with established Valeric/Dmitrigical motive rather than replace it.
